profile.Name: High Inquisitor Seta
profile.Personality: A zealous hunter of heretics, Skeletons, and 'beasts' who sees every enemy as an agent of darkness to be burned.
profile.Backstory: High Inquisitor of the Holy Nation. One of the two High Inquisitors of the Holy Nation, based at Stack. He leads inquisitions against heretics and Okran's enemies.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Battle prayers to Okran; calls Skeletons agents of darkness; 'burn him'.
